demands.description: Development and service tickets and demands, stored in Darckware.
demands.selectHint: Select a demand to see its details.

text.wait-customer: What is missing from the customer (internal note)

dialog.withEmail: Queue an e-mail to the customer (sent only after approval)
dialog.subject: Subject

form.title: New client demand
form.kindHelp: Ticket: customer with a support contract. Demand: one-off request or project.
form.subject: Title

flow.title: Progress
flow.reopenHint: Reopening sets the item back to New.

actionHelp.start: Moves to In progress: someone is working on it.
actionHelp.wait-customer: Pauses while waiting on the client (information, access, approval). The client's reply resumes the work.
actionHelp.resolve: Closes the work: enter the resolution and the hours spent, which consume the plan's quota.
actionHelp.reopen: Back to New when the problem persists or the client asks again.

workHelp.log: Records a period of work (start and end; it may run from one day into the next).
workHelp.project: Development demands only: opens the project in the Software Factory.

emails.title: E-mail approval
emails.description: Every e-mail to a client is sent by Lara only after it is approved here, in the exact version shown.
emails.editWarning: Saving creates a new version, which must be approved again.
emails.confirmApproveBody: Lara sends version {{version}} to {{to}} right away. Sending cannot be undone.
emails.confirmCancelBody: The e-mail leaves the queue and will not be sent.

accounts.title: Clients and contracts
accounts.description: Darckware clients, their contracts and turning leads into clients.
accounts.hoursCycle: {{used}} of {{quota}} h used this cycle · {{extra}} h extra

conversions.title: Leads ready to become clients
conversions.pickSearch: Search by name, company or e-mail
conversions.explain: Creates the client, its authorized primary contact and the contract in Darckware, and queues the welcome e-mail for approval.
conversions.done: Client created. The welcome e-mail is in the approval queue.

project.title: Open a Software Factory project
project.explain: Creates the project (and the product, if new) linked to this client and this demand; the demand moves to in progress.
project.unlinkedHint: Products with no client get linked to this client.
project.noClient: This demand has no client yet (it came from a lead). Convert the lead to a client to open a project.

factory.title: Software Factory
factory.none: No products or projects for this client yet.
factory.linkPick: Select a product with no client

time.title: Log hours
time.rounding: Counts against the contract quota, rounded up to 30-minute blocks.
time.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
time.spentHelp: Required: consumes the contract quota (30-minute blocks).
time.spentNoClient: No client linked: there is no quota to consume.
time.total: Period total: {{duration}} · counts {{billable}} against the quota

report.generated: Report for {{start}} to {{end}} queued for approval.
report.exists: This cycle's report was already in the queue.

errors.generic: The operation could not be completed.
errors.server: Server error. Please try again shortly.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.no_recipient: This item has no requester e-mail: enter the recipient.
errors.hours_required: Enter the time spent: resolving a client's item consumes their quota.
errors.product_choice: Pick an existing product or enter the name of a new one.
errors.product_other_client: Product "{{product}}" already belongs to another client ({{client}}).
errors.no_client: This demand has no client yet (it came from a lead): convert the lead into a client first.
errors.project_exists: Project "{{project}}" already exists for this item.
errors.version_not_in_product: The chosen version does not belong to this product.
errors.all_versions_published: Every version of this product is published: create a new version in the Cockpit.

client.newExplain: Registers the company and its primary contact in Darckware. Portal access is granted afterwards, from the client's page.
client.editExplain: The primary contact follows the name, e-mail and phone. The e-mail is also the portal login.
client.activateBody: The client shows up again for new work and can be given portal access.
client.deactivateBody: The client can no longer sign in to the portal and no longer shows up for new work. Contracts and history are kept; you can reactivate later.

portal.title: Portal access

state.notUsed: The client has not signed in to the portal yet.
state.mustChange: Access granted: the client still has to change the temporary password.
state.active: The client uses the portal with their own password.

portal.help: The temporary password is shown only once; at first sign-in the portal makes the client change it. Generating another one invalidates the previous one (also the way back in for a forgotten password).
portal.confirmBody: A temporary password will be created so the client can sign in to the portal and change it at first sign-in.
portal.confirmReissue: The client's current password will stop working. They sign in with the new temporary password and change it at first sign-in.
portal.issuedBody: Send these details to the client through a secure channel. The password will not be shown again.

registrations.title: Registrations requested by agents
registrations.explain: Agents don't create clients: the registration only happens when you approve it.
registrations.approveExplain: Requested by {{who}}. Check and adjust the details before approving; the client is created with the authorized primary contact.
